name: Phyrexian invasion
description: The Phyrexian invasion was Elesh Norn's invasion of the Multiverse, an attack whose effects are recalled across many planes.

summary.text: The Phyrexian invasion was Elesh Norn's invasion of the Multiverse, an attack whose effects are recalled across many planes.

bio.text: On Ravnica, Teysa reminded Kaya that she owed the Orzhov for not being on Ravnica during the invasion.
Following the invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
The invasion damaged Strixhaven and killed many faculty.

status.text: The latest story, in March 2026, speaks of the invasion in the past, as the attack that damaged Strixhaven and killed many faculty.

timeline.summary: Teysa reminds Kaya that she owes the Orzhov for not being on Ravnica during the invasion.
timeline.quote: You owe me this night, Kaya.

timeline.summary: Following the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
timeline.quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion damages Strixhaven and kills many faculty.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion, much of the university campus was damaged or destroyed, and a significant number of faculty lost their lives.

pages_say.description: A past war ended by Urza's final spell.
Elesh Norn's invasion of the Multiverse.
The recent attack on Ravnica and the Multiverse that left chaos and loss.
The invasion of the Multiverse that cost Nashi his mother.
The invasion of Innistrad whose forces failed to adapt to its magic.
The invasion after which Tezzeret acquired freedom and a darksteel body.
The Phyrexian assault that destroyed the plane's fragile power balance and forced its species to cooperate.
The Phyrexian attack that Kirol recalls was preceded by spontaneous natural spirals.
The Phyrexian attack that damaged or destroyed much of Strixhaven's campus and killed faculty.
